Migrate.// Policy: Validate refuses to start while any module context has a pending migration, so a deployment applies them before the host runs, from CI/CD: tools/ef/module-migrate.sh apply <Provider> "<connection>" for the module contexts, then tools/ef/dual-migrate.sh apply --postgresql (ELSA_SECRETS_EF_POSTGRESQL) for Secrets, which the first script does not cover. Set AutoMigrate to hand that back to shell activation.
